messages:
Rina: NovaTech signed NDA, wants a 4-week co-sell pilot. Primary asks: SSO, EU data residency, throughput guarantee, and SOC2 answers. Can we support?
Theo: we can. Recommendation is Dedicated with VPC peering for telemetry + optional Private for KMS. Need expected concurrency and median request size.
Hawk (NovaTech): thanks. Target is 150 concurrent chat sessions, avg 350 tokens/session, p95 latency target 400ms. Must run in EU region, keys in their KMS account. Also need a short whitebox on inference quantization impacts.
Carlos: for 150 conc and 350 tokens, propose 3xA10G equiv with 30GB KV cache. Quantization: we'll recommend int8 for throughput, note slight perf regression on complex reasoning. I'll draft quantization tradeoffs doc.
Elena: security checklist 1: SAML metadata, SP-initiated SSO, attribute mappings, and a CIS-style network diagram. Hawk, can NovaTech provide IdP metadata and IP allowlist?
Hawk (NovaTech): will share IdP metadata and a tentative IP list. Also legal asked about access to raw logs; will we restrict to aggregated telemetry only?
Rina: for pilot we can provide aggregated telemetry + trace IDs on request. Raw logs will require a separate data access agreement. Noted for legal.
Theo: commercial: we can quote a pilot rate for Dedicated for 4 weeks + option to convert to Reserved with a 6-month commit. Need to confirm burst policy (we recommend 20% headroom).
Hawk (NovaTech): 20% burst ok. Need sample invoice line items: dedicated base, burst buffer, data egress, and enablement hours.
Rina: I'll assemble a short pricing table with examples. Also propose a 90-minute technical enablement in Week 0 and a 30-minute executive check at Week 2.
Carlos: infra runbook highlights: provisioning (24-48h), SAML test flow, load test (k6 script), canary steps, fallback to hosted small model (<50 rps) if Dedicated unhealthy. I'll attach k6 snippet in a sec.
Elena: SOC2 Qs: encryption at rest? yes. KMS integration? yes for Private; for Dedicated hosted we support CMEK in many regions 1, will confirm EU. Vulnerability scanning? weekly automated scans + manual quarterly.
Hawk (NovaTech): good. Also vendor questionnaire includes data deletion policy 1: can you guarantee deletion of customer prompt logs on request?
Carlos: yes, we have programmatic retention/deletion via control plane. Can set retention to 0 days and trigger purge. We'll include API call example.
Rina: blockers: (1) confirm EU KMS compatibility, (2) provide k6 script and runbook, (3) deliver pricing by Wednesday, (4) schedule enablement. Who picks up each?
Theo: I'll confirm KMS EU support and write the pricing lines. Carlos: take the k6 + runbook + fallback steps. Elena: I'll prepare SOC2 excerpt and data-deletion API sample.
deploy-bot: infra-ticket created: dedicated/nova-pilot-2002345678; status: pending-approval
Hawk (NovaTech): sharing IdP metadata and IP list via secure link. Also sending their security questionnaire PDF.
Rina: thanks. We'll triage the questionnaire and post answers here. Plan: kickoff call Thursday 10am CET. Can everyone make it?
Carlos: yes. I'll have load test ready.
Elena: yes.
Theo: yes, will have pricing draft.
Hawk (NovaTech): confirmed 10am CET. Appreciate the quick turnaround. :rocket:
